<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-PT">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>PLACE — Cetelem · BNP Paribas Personal Finance</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Nunito:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    /* Cetelem brand — sampled from official wordmark & mascot */
    --cetelem-green: #2D9442;        /* primary brand green (wordmark) */
    --cetelem-green-deep: #1F6E2F;   /* darker variant for headlines/dark surfaces */
    --cetelem-green-darker: #14471D; /* deepest, for backgrounds */
    --cetelem-lime: #95C11F;         /* expression / accent (bright lime) */
    --cetelem-lime-soft: #C8DC6E;    /* soft lime tint */
    --bnpp-green: #007A3D;           /* BNP Paribas Personal Finance accent */

    /* Neutrals */
    --bg: #FAFAF6;
    --surface: #FFFFFF;
    --surface-alt: #F2F5EC;
    --border: #E1E6D6;
    --ink: #14241A;
    --ink-soft: #4A5A4A;
    --ink-muted: #8A958A;

    /* PDCA status colors */
    --status-plan: #4F8DD9;
    --status-do: #E89923;
    --status-check: #9C5BD1;
    --status-act: #2D9442;

    /* Shape */
    --r-sm: 8px;
    --r-md: 14px;
    --r-lg: 20px;
    --r-xl: 28px;
    --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,36,26,0.04), 0 2px 8px rgba(20,36,26,0.04);
    --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(20,36,26,0.06), 0 12px 32px rgba(20,36,26,0.06);
    --shadow-lg: 0 8px 24px rgba(20,36,26,0.10), 0 24px 64px rgba(20,36,26,0.12);
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  html, body {
    font-family: 'Nunito', system-ui, sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  .container { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 32px; }

  /* ===== TOP BAR ===== */
  .topbar {
    background: var(--surface);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 14px 0;
  }
  .topbar-inner {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 24px;
  }
  .brand-block {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 18px;
  }
  .cetelem-logo {
    height: 32px;
    width: auto;
    display: block;
  }
  .brand-divider {
    width: 1px;
    height: 28px;
    background: var(--border);
  }
  .platform-mark {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }
  .platform-name {
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: var(--cetelem-green-deep);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  .platform-sub {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--ink-muted);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }
  .corporate-mark {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--surface-alt);
    margin-right: 8px;
  }
  .corporate-stars {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2,6px);
    gap: 2px;
  }
  .corporate-star {
    width: 6px; height: 6px;
    background: var(--bnpp-green);
    clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 61% 35%, 98% 35%, 68% 57%, 79% 91%, 50% 70%, 21% 91%, 32% 57%, 2% 35%, 39% 35%);
  }
  .corporate-text {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    line-height: 1.1;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .corporate-text small {
    display: block;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--ink-muted);
    font-size: 9px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }
  .user-area {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
  }
  .user-info {
    text-align: right;
  }
  .user-name {
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 14px;
  }
  .user-role {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--ink-muted);
  }
  .user-avatar {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--cetelem-green), var(--cetelem-green-deep));
    color: white;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  /* ===== NAV ===== */
  .nav {
    background: var(--surface);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 10;
  }
  .nav-inner {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    overflow-x: auto;
  }
  .nav-tab {
    padding: 18px 22px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition: color 0.15s;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .nav-tab:hover { color: var(--ink); }
  .nav-tab.active { color: var(--cetelem-green-deep); }
  .nav-tab.active::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -1px;
    left: 22px;
    right: 22px;
    height: 3px;
    background: var(--cetelem-green);
    border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
  }
  .nav-tab-icon { font-size: 16px; }
  .nav-spacer { flex: 1; }
  .nav-cta {
    margin: 10px 0 10px auto;
  }

  /* ===== BUTTONS ===== */
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 12px 22px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 14px;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.18s ease;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .btn-primary {
    background: var(--cetelem-green);
    color: white;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(45,148,66,0.30);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover {
    background: var(--cetelem-green-deep);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(45,148,66,0.40);
  }
  .btn-lime {
    background: var(--cetelem-lime);
    color: var(--cetelem-green-darker);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(149,193,31,0.40);
  }
  .btn-lime:hover {
    background: #A8D324;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }
  .btn-ghost {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ink);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
  }
  .btn-ghost:hover {
    border-color: var(--cetelem-green);
    color: var(--cetelem-green-deep);
  }
  .btn-lg { padding: 16px 30px; font-size: 16px; }

  /* ===== HERO ===== */
  .hero {
    margin-top: 32px;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
    border-radius: var(--r-xl);
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at top right, rgba(149,193,31,0.20), transparent 60%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, var(--cetelem-green-darker) 0%, var(--cetelem-green-deep) 50%, var(--cetelem-green) 100%);
    color: white;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  }
  /* Scale pattern overlay — subtle Cetelem brand motif */
  .hero-pattern {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    opacity: 0.08;
    pointer-events: none;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='80' height='40' viewBox='0 0 80 40'><path d='M 0 40 Q 20 0 40 40 Q 60 0 80 40' fill='none' stroke='white' stroke-width='2.5'/></svg>");
    background-size: 80px 40px;
  }
  .hero-inner {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 360px;
    padding: 56px 56px 48px;
    gap: 32px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .hero-content { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
  .hero-eyebrow {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .hero-eyebrow-dot {
    width: 8px; height: 8px;
    background: var(--cetelem-lime);
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--cetelem-lime);
  }
  .hero-title {
    font-size: 56px;
    font-weight: 900;
    line-height: 1.02;
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  .hero-title-accent { color: var(--cetelem-lime); }
  .hero-sub {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.55;
    opacity: 0.92;
    max-width: 520px;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
  }
  .hero-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .btn-hero-primary {
    background: var(--cetelem-lime);
    color: var(--cetelem-green-darker);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(149,193,31,0.45);
  }
  .btn-hero-primary:hover {
    background: white;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }
  .btn-hero-ghost {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    color: white;
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  }
  .btn-hero-ghost:hover {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  }

  .hero-mascot {
    position: relative;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: flex-end;
  }
  .hero-mascot img {
    height: 380px;
    width: auto;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.40));
    animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes float {
    0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
    50% { transform: translateY(-10px); }
  }

  .hero::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 320px; height: 320px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(149,193,31,0.30), transparent 65%);
    top: -100px; right: 25%;
    filter: blur(4px);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ===== STATS ===== */
  .stats {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }
  .stat {
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--r-lg);
    padding: 22px 22px 20px;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  .stat:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    border-color: var(--cetelem-green);
  }
  .stat-icon {
    width: 40px; height: 40px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: grid; place-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    font-size: 18px;
  }
  .stat-icon.plan { background: rgba(79,141,217,0.12); color: var(--status-plan); }
  .stat-icon.do { background: rgba(232,153,35,0.12); color: var(--status-do); }
  .stat-icon.check { background: rgba(156,91,209,0.12); color: var(--status-check); }
  .stat-icon.act { background: rgba(45,148,66,0.15); color: var(--cetelem-green-deep); }
  .stat-value {
    font-size: 32px;
    font-weight: 900;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .stat-label {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .stat-trend {
    margin-top: 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--cetelem-green-deep);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  /* ===== TWO-COLUMN ===== */
  .grid-main {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr;
    gap: 24px;
    margin-bottom: 48px;
  }

  .section {
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--r-lg);
    padding: 28px;
  }
  .section-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 22px;
  }
  .section-title {
    font-size: 19px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  .section-sub {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--ink-muted);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .section-link {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--cetelem-green-deep);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .section-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

  /* ===== INITIATIVE CARDS ===== */
  .card-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
  .init-card {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 16px;
    background: var(--surface-alt);
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: var(--r-md);
    transition: all 0.18s;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .init-card:hover {
    background: white;
    border-color: var(--cetelem-green);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  }
  .init-avatar {
    width: 42px; height: 42px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--cetelem-green-deep), var(--cetelem-green));
    color: white;
    display: grid; place-items: center;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 14px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .init-avatar.mj { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D97757, #E89923); }
  .init-avatar.rs { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #9C5BD1, #6F44A6); }
  .init-avatar.jf { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4F8DD9, #2E6BB8); }
  .init-body { min-width: 0; }
  .init-title {
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 15px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .init-meta {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--ink-muted);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .init-team {
    background: rgba(45,148,66,0.12);
    color: var(--cetelem-green-deep);
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .phase-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 6px 12px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .phase-p { background: rgba(79,141,217,0.15); color: var(--status-plan); }
  .phase-d { background: rgba(232,153,35,0.15); color: var(--status-do); }
  .phase-c { background: rgba(156,91,209,0.15); color: var(--status-check); }
  .phase-a { background: rgba(45,148,66,0.18); color: var(--cetelem-green-deep); }
  .phase-dot {
    width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: currentColor;
  }

  /* ===== EMPTY STATE ===== */
  .empty-state {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 36px 20px 28px;
    background: var(--surface-alt);
    border-radius: var(--r-md);
    border: 1.5px dashed var(--border);
  }
  .empty-mascot {
    width: 110px;
    height: 110px;
    margin: 0 auto 16px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: white;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(45,148,66,0.18);
    border: 3px solid white;
  }
  .empty-mascot img {
    width: 115%;
    height: 115%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center 15%;
  }
  .empty-title {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 800;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .empty-text {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    max-width: 280px;
    margin: 0 auto 16px;
  }

  /* ===== PDCA WIDGET ===== */
  .pdca-widget {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 8px 0;
  }
  .pdca-svg {
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: block;
  }
  .pdca-legend {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-top: 20px;
    text-align: left;
  }
  .legend-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: var(--surface-alt);
    border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  }
  .legend-letter {
    width: 28px; height: 28px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: grid; place-items: center;
    color: white;
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  .legend-letter.p { background: var(--status-plan); }
  .legend-letter.d { background: var(--status-do); }
  .legend-letter.c { background: var(--status-check); }
  .legend-letter.a { background: var(--cetelem-green); }
  .legend-text { font-weight: 600; }

  /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */
  .fade-in {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(12px);
    animation: fadeIn 0.6s forwards;
  }
  .fade-in:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.05s; }
  .fade-in:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.12s; }
  .fade-in:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.19s; }
  .fade-in:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.26s; }
  @keyframes fadeIn {
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  /* ===== ANNOTATION ===== */
  .annotation {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF8E1, #FFF3CD);
    border-left: 4px solid #E89923;
    padding: 14px 20px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    border-radius: var(--r-sm);
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #5C4A1F;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .annotation b { color: #3D3014; }

  /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
  footer {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 24px 0 32px;
    margin-top: 24px;
  }
  .footer-inner {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 24px;
    color: var(--ink-muted);
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .footer-brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
  }
  .footer-cetelem {
    height: 22px;
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  /* Responsive */
  @media (max-width: 980px) {
    .hero-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 40px 32px; }
    .hero-mascot img { height: 240px; }
    .stats { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .grid-main { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .hero-title { font-size: 40px; }
    .brand-block { gap: 12px; }
    .cetelem-logo { height: 26px; }
    .corporate-mark { display: none; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- TOP BAR -->
<div class="topbar">
  <div class="container topbar-inner">
    <div class="brand-block">
      <img class="cetelem-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Cetelem">
      <div class="brand-divider"></div>
      <div class="platform-mark">
        <span class="platform-name">PLACE</span>
        <span class="platform-sub">Plataforma de melhoria contínua</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="user-area">
      <div class="corporate-mark">
        <div class="corporate-stars">
          <div class="corporate-star"></div>
          <div class="corporate-star"></div>
          <div class="corporate-star"></div>
          <div class="corporate-star"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="corporate-text">
          BNP PARIBAS
          <small>Personal Finance</small>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="user-info">
        <div class="user-name">Amadeu Mendes</div>
        <div class="user-role">Mentor · Bootstrap</div>
      </div>
      <div class="user-avatar">AM</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- NAV -->
<div class="nav">
  <div class="container nav-inner">
    <button class="nav-tab active"><svg class="nav-tab-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 11l9-8 9 8v10a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z"/><polyline points="9 22 9 12 15 12 15 22"/></svg> Início</button>
    <button class="nav-tab">As minhas iniciativas</button>
    <button class="nav-tab">Geral</button>
    <button class="nav-tab">Mentoria</button>
    <button class="nav-tab">Gestor</button>
    <button class="nav-tab">Catálogo</button>
    <div class="nav-spacer"></div>
    <button class="btn btn-primary nav-cta">+ Partilhar uma ideia</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="container">

  <!-- HERO -->
  <section class="hero">
    <div class="hero-pattern"></div>
    <div class="hero-inner">
      <div class="hero-content">
        <div class="hero-eyebrow">
          <span class="hero-eyebrow-dot"></span>
          PLACE · Plan · Do · Check · Act
        </div>
        <h1 class="hero-title">Olá, Amadeu.<br><span class="hero-title-accent">O que vamos mudar hoje?</span></h1>

<script>
  document.querySelectorAll('.btn-primary, .btn-hero-primary, .btn-lime').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      btn.style.transform = 'scale(0.96)';
      setTimeout(() => { btn.style.transform = ''; }, 150);
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      tab.classList.add('active');
    });
  });
</script>
